fields.name: pdb
fields.label: Protein PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A PROTEIN PDB HERE

fields.name: chain
fields.label: Chain (optional)
fields.help: Restrict the analysis to one chain. Empty analyses the whole structure.

fields.name: distance
fields.label: Aggregation sphere radius (angstroms)
fields.help: Residues within this radius of each alpha carbon contribute to its score.

fields.name: dynamic
fields.label: Score over a CABS-flex ensemble
fields.help: Much slower, but accounts for flexibility instead of scoring one conformation.

fields.name: mutate
fields.label: Mutations to score (optional)
fields.help: One per line, as wild-type residue, mutant residue, position, and chain, for example MW1A. Needs FoldX.

fields.name: auto_mutation
fields.label: Solubility mutations to suggest
fields.help: Ask A3D to propose this many stability-aware solubility mutations. 0 skips the search. Needs FoldX.
